name: tmux-claude
description: Drive tmux from Claude Code — split panes, open windows, send commands, read output — plus fork-tmux for tracked tmux-window forks (Claude-session forking, rewind, YOLO Codex/Gemini delegation windows), handoff for continuing a long conversation in a fresh Claude session, controller for supervising other Claude windows (watch, answer, compact, coordinate merges), illbeback/imback for the human-driven controller compaction handshake, and an opinionated tmux.conf + plugin set.

window_mode.title: Delegated window mode (YOLO/CHICKEN)
window_mode.description: Default permission mode for delegated agent windows and panes. YOLO = auto-approve everything (claude --dangerously-skip-permissions, codex --yolo, gemini -y). CHICKEN = keep permission/approval prompts. Per-request wording ("safe window", "yolo window") still overrides.
